# CURP birthplace-code source

`curp_birthplace_codes.csv` pins the two-character birthplace codes used in positions 12–13 of a CURP. The 32 federal-entity codes and `NE` for birth outside Mexico are transcribed from the catalogue published with the 2021 *Reglas para la ejecución de los procedimientos para la asignación de la Clave Única de Registro de Población* by the Registro Nacional de Población.

- Official page: <https://www.gob.mx/segob%7Crenapo/documentos/reglas-para-la-ejecucion-de-los-procedimientos-para-la-asignacion-de-la-clave-unica-de-registro-de-poblacion>
- Official attachment: <https://www.gob.mx/cms/uploads/attachment/file/681698/reglas_para_la_ejecucion_de_los_procedimientos_asignacion_de_la_curp.pdf>
- Publication date: 2021-12-17
- Accessed: 2026-08-09
- Attachment SHA-256 on access: `c41fe8044a73e12802ca615d33dc3660c7e120d39603c77faa7bb50ab4d39be8`

The file contains catalogue facts only. It is not a CURP registry, contains no personal data and does not establish registry validation.
